comments.author: bakabaka
comments.body: Is this the quest i must to do to start the legacy "Ephesus" ?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Do every single quest listed under Quest Chain, followed by this quest. The Legacy theme unlocks after you complete the quest's discovery.

In fact, all legacy info (including where to make discoveries or visit for footprints, gain clues, etc.) can be found in the relevant Legacy tabs here: tinyurl.com/RailwayUWO

comments.author: Beomi
comments.body: To avoid the repeated reaction of "Book of Wisdom" at Southwest Salonika, I recommend you to proceed this quest.
